get.description: Returns details about the authenticated API key including vendor, organization, committee, and state information.

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing API key

post.description:
This endpoint is used to post interactions data to the Interactions API that will be published to Pub/Sub.
A maximum of 100 interactions can be submitted per request.

get.summary: Get external API transactions by interactionId
get.description: Get all external API transaction records for the specified interaction.

parameters.name: interactionId
parameters.description: ID of the interaction to retrieve records for.

parameters.name: showOnlyFailedTransactions
parameters.description: When true, will return only transactions with Failed, Invalid, or Duplicate status. True by default.

get.summary: Get external API transaction logs by date range
get.description: Get all external API transaction records within the date range specified, for a maximum of up to a 30 day span.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Beginning of date range to show transactions for (inclusive). Must be provided in UTC, and be within 30 days of endDate.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description:
End of date range to show transactions for (inclusive). Defaults to current date/time if not provided. Must be provided in UTC if specified,
            and be within 30 days of startDate.

parameters.name: showOnlyFailedTransactions
parameters.description: When true, will return only transactions with Failed, Invalid, or Duplicate status. True by default.

get.summary: Get Exchange pipeline statuses by correlation or interaction ID
get.description:
Returns Exchange pipeline statuses filtered by either correlationId or interactionId.
Supports cursor-based pagination.

parameters.name: correlationId
parameters.description: The correlation ID returned from the initial publish response.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous response's nextCursor field.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 100, max 1000).

get.summary: Get Exchange pipeline statuses by date range
get.description:
Returns Exchange pipeline statuses for interactions published within the specified date range.
Supports cursor-based pagination. Maximum date range is 30 days.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: End of date range (inclusive, UTC). Defaults to current UTC time.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous response's nextCursor field.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 100, max 1000).

400.description: Invalid date range, limit, or cursor

activistCodeId.description:
Unique identifier for an activist code;
the value may be retrieved from the system that sourced the activist code

text.description: The question or information prompted during the interaction

ActivistCodeOutcomeDetails.title: Activist Code Outcome

type.description: This field categorizes the type of detailed outcome information being provided.

ActivistCodeOutcomeDetails.description: Represents an activist code (e.g. affiliation, activity, or interest) acquired during an interaction.

addressLine1.description: The primary street address (e.g., house number and street name).

addressLine2.description: The secondary address information (e.g., apartment, suite, unit number).

state.description: The state or region of the address.

postalCode.description: The postal (ZIP) code for the address. Can accept ZIP5, ZIP+4, or ZIP9 format.

AddressChannelDetails.title: Address Channel

id.description: Optional; unique identifier for any known id for the channel `type`

type.description: Specifies that the `type` of channel used was an `address` and a full address must be provided as the `value`.

AddressChannelDetails.description: Represents that an address was used for an interaction.

type.description:
Type of the canvasser identifier specified in 'id'.
Required when Canvasser is provided.

id.description:
The actual canvasser identifier used during the outreach attempt.
Examples: user ID, employee number, volunteer ID, etc.
Required when Canvasser is provided.

CanvasserDetails.description: Represents canvasser details for the individual who conducted the outreach attempt.

type.description: Type of the committee identifier specified in 'id', representing the source context of the interaction.

CommitteeDetails.description: Represents details for the entities that conducted or logged the outreach attempt.

CommunicationConsentOutcomeDetails.title: Communication Consent Outcome

type.description: This field categorizes the type of detailed outcome information being provided.

CommunicationConsentOutcomeDetails.description: Represents a communication consent response ("opted_in" or "opted_out").

email.description: Email addresses of the person being interacted with.

phone.description: Phone numbers of the person being interacted with. Should be in E.164 format (e.g. +1234567890).

address.description: Physical addresses of the person being interacted with.

firstName.description: Optional first name field for person being interacted with.

middleName.description: Optional middle name field for person being interacted with.

lastName.description: Optional last name field for person being interacted with.

socialHandle.description: Optional social media handles for person being interacted with.

ContactInfo.description:
Represents contact information for a person being interacted with, including email, phone, or address.
Can be used to match a person if an Id is not known

DynamicChannelDetails.title: Channel

id.description: Optional; unique identifier for any known id for the channel `type`

type.description:
Type of the channel specified in 'value'. Required when Channel is provided.
            
Recognized types:
- "phone_number": Indicates `value` is a phone number; `value` must be in E.164 format (e.g., +14155552671).
- "email": Indicates `value` is an email address.
- [any other identifier]: Any type not listed above. `value` can be a string, an int or an arbitrary object.

value.description:
The actual channel used during the outreach attempt. This field can be provided as a string or int though only the object form is shown here.

Examples: +14155552671, name@org.org, @handle.

Required when Channel is provided.

DynamicChannelDetails.description:
Represents a generic Channel Details object;
does not have any validation rules or JSON format limitations except where noted below.

DynamicOutcomeDetails.title: Outcome

type.description: This field categorizes the type of detailed outcome information being provided.

value.description: Provide additional details of the outreach attempt. This field can be provided as a string or int though only the object form is shown here.

DynamicOutcomeDetails.description:
Represents a generic Outcome Details object;
does not have any validation rules or JSON format limitations

ExchangeInteractionStatus.description: Status of an interaction's progress through the Exchange data pipeline.

publishTime.description: Timestamp when the interaction was received into the Exchange pipeline (Pub/Sub publish time).

ExchangeInteractionStatusDto.description: Per-interaction status through the Exchange data pipeline.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor token for fetching the next page. Null if there are no more results.

ExchangeInteractionStatusDtoCursorPagina.description: Extends Minerva.Dto.Api.GetResponseDto`1 with cursor-based pagination support.

dateCreatedUtc.description: The UTC date and time at which the request was received.

interactionId.description: ID used to identify the interaction; ID will have been returned from the initial publish response.

correlationId.description: DDx API request identifier, provided as X-Correlation-Id on interactions responses for use linking all interactions in a request.

logs.description: Any logs associated with this external API transaction.

ExternalApiTransactionDto.description: For an interaction request with an external destination configured, this represents the status of the interaction data sent to that destination.

responseStatusCode.description: HTTP response code received for external API request.

response.description: Response JSON received for external API request.

dateCreatedUtc.description: Timestamp for when the external API request was made.

ExternalApiTransactionLogDto.description: Log data for an external API transaction to a configured Interactions API destination.

type.description: Type of the initiative identifier specified in 'id'.

id.description: The actual initiative identifier, such as a campaign ID.

InitiativeDto.description: Represents an initiative associated with an interaction, such as a campaign identifier.

interactionId.description:
Optional ID used to identify a specific interaction.
This ID should only be provided in the initial request when re-sending data, and must use DDx-provided
interactionId value. If an existing ID is not provided to mark the interaction as a retry, Interactions API
will populate this ID field and include it in the response for future use if the interaction needs to be re-sent.

person.description:
Optional array of person identifiers representing all IDs from any vendor system for the person interacted with. Each identifier can
contain an ID and type of ID indicating source system. If contact information for a person involved in the interaction is not provided, at least one ID is required. 
A maximum of 100 IDs are allowed per interaction.
An ID of type 'VAN' must be present if VAN is included as a destination, even if contact information is provided. Each person identifier type can appear at most once
in the array (i.e. no duplicate types are allowed).

channel.description:
Channel-of-contact details used during the outreach attempt.
If the `type` is recognized as an Address Channel (type = "address"), the `value` will be deserialized to that object type.
Other string-based types have specific validation documented in the "Channel" section below, like "phone_number".
If the `type` is unrecognized, the payload will be deserialized to an unvalidated, loosely typed object for flexibility.

stateCode.description:
2-character US state postal abbreviation (e.g., AL, WY).
Must be a valid uppercase state code.

attemptDateTime.description:
The date and time when the outreach attempt occurred, as reported by the vendor
and normalized to Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

committee.description:
Array of entities (campaign, state party, etc.) that conducted or logged the outreach attempt.
Committee objects consist of a type and an identifier, and at least one committee must be provided.

canvasser.description:
Array of canvasser details for the individual who conducted the outreach attempt, as reported by the vendor.
Optional object containing identifier and identifier type.

vendorSource.description:
Canonical name of the vendor or tool used to facilitate the outreach attempt.
This field reflects the platform through which the contact was made, not necessarily where the data was ingested from.

type.description: This field categorizes the type of detailed outcome information being provided.

outcomesDetailed.description:
Optional array of objects that provide additional context around the results of an interaction, such as activist codes or survey responses.
If the type is recognized as an Activist Code Outcome (type = "activist_code"),
Communication Consent Outcome (type = "communication_consent"), or Survey Response Outcome
(type = "survey_response") it will be deserialized to that type.
If the type is unrecognized, it will be deserialized to an unvalidated, loosely typed object for flexibility.

threadId.description:
Unique identifier for interactions that took place during the same conversation or set of conversations.
Used to group related interactions together. Maximum length of 100 characters.

jsonMetadata.description:
Additional metadata in JSON format related to the interaction.
Must be valid JSON when provided. Can contain arbitrary structured data relevant to the interaction.

initiative.description:
Optional array of initiatives associated with the interaction, such as campaign IDs.
Each initiative can contain a type and an identifier.

InteractionDto.description: Represents a single interaction record containing voter outreach attempt data.

contactTypeId.description:
VAN contact type ID. Must match a Contact Type accessible to the destination VAN committee.
See https://docs.ngpvan.com/reference/canvassresponsescontacttypes for details on retrieving accessible contact types.

resultCodeId.description:
VAN contact attempt result code, representing the result of that contact attempt. Result code availibility varies based on
contact type, so this value must represent a code that is available to the Contact Type ID specified above.
See https://docs.ngpvan.com/reference/canvassresponsesresultcodes to view Result Codes accessible to the destination VAN committee.

InteractionVanFieldsDto.description:
VAN-specific data for an interaction. Must be provided if if the Interactions API Key used on the request
is configured with VAN as a destination.

MercuryDestinationVanApiKeyDto.description: VAN-specific DTO containing VAN key profile details along with DDx configuration for that VAN key for the linked destination.

count.description: Number of records returned in the response `data` array

id.description:
A primary identifier for tracking individual voters. This can be an integer (e.g. for DNC person_ids),
a string (for UUIDs, phone numbers), or other identifier formats depending on the source system.
Used to link voter records across different data sources and track in-state voter history over time.

type.description:
Type of identifier or source system that generated the id.
Examples include "VAN", "phone", "slimCRM", "DNC", "SOS", etc. 
This field indicates the origin or authority of the person identifier.

PersonIdentifier.description: Represents a person involved in an interaction, including their identifier and optional contact information.

isVanDestination.description:
Indicator of whether the destination integrates with NGP VAN
and requires an associated VAN External API Key

questionId.description:
Unique identifier for the survey question being asked;
the value may be retrieved from the system that sourced the question

questionText.description: The question text presented during an interaction

responseId.description:
Unique identifier for the survey response associated with the question;
the value may be retrieved from the system that sourced the question

responseText.description:
An answer to the question.
Required when Survey Question text is provided.

SurveyResponseOutcomeDetails.title: Survey Response Outcome

type.description: This field categorizes the type of detailed outcome information being provided.

SurveyResponseOutcomeDetails.description: Represents a survey question and response obtained from an interaction.

VanApiKeyDto.description: VAN-specific external key fields, for display and other front-end use

publicKeyId.description: Unique identifier that specifies which API Key is being used

expireDate.description: The date and time the API Key is set to expire. The time should be evaluated in Eastern Time.

destinations.description: The destinations enabled for this API key

Basic.description: Enter your API key in the password field (leave username empty)
